Add createPatch: a JSON Patch of the changes between two documents

createPatch(from, to) returns the RFC 6902 patch that turns from into to, and
describes only what changed: equal members produce nothing, and an array's
common prefix and suffix are skipped so a single inserted or removed element
is one operation. Implements task-005.
